units.source_text: 桃园宫邸的北门，杂人进出频繁。

en.t: At the north gate of the Peach Garden palace residence, all sorts of people were constantly coming and going.

units.source_text: 公子倘也走这门，似乎太轻率了。

en.t: If the young lord were to use this gate as well, it would seem far too careless.

units.source_text: 他想走西门进去，但西门一向紧闭。

en.t: He wanted to enter through the west gate, but that gate was always kept tightly shut.

units.source_text: 便派人进去通报五公主，请她开西门。

en.t: So he sent someone inside to inform the Fifth Princess and ask her to open the west gate.

units.source_text: 五公主以为源氏公子今天不会来访，闻讯吃了一惊，立刻叫人去开门。

en.t: The Fifth Princess had thought Prince Genji would not visit today, and when she heard the news she was startled and immediately ordered someone to open the gate.

units.source_text: 管门的人冷得缩头缩脚，慌慌张张地前往开门。

en.t: The gatekeeper, huddled up from the cold, hurried off in a fluster to open it.
But just then the gate proved difficult to open.

units.source_text: 这里没有别的男用人，他只得独自用力推拉，嘴里发牢骚：“这个锁锈得好厉害！

en.t: There were no other male servants there, so he had to push and pull at it by himself, grumbling, "This lock is terribly rusted!
It will not open no matter what I do!"

units.source_text: 源氏公子听了，不胜感慨。

en.t: When Prince Genji heard this, he was overcome with emotion.

units.source_text: 他想：“亲王逝世，还是昨今之事，却似乎已历三年了。

en.t: He thought, "The prince's death was only yesterday or today, and yet it feels as though three years have already passed.

units.source_text: 眼看世变如此无常，但终于舍不了这电光石火之身，而留恋着四时风物之美，人生实甚可哀！”

en.t: Though we see how impermanent the changes of this world are, we still cannot let go of this fleeting body and cling to the beauty of the four seasons; human life is truly pitiable!"
He then casually composed a verse inspired by the scene before him:
